case: A capacity measure added to the registered vocabulary that no chapter names.
why: F6C-06 is prose pointing at a capacity row with no measure behind it. The opposite failure is the one this fixture holds: a measure with no prose behind it -- a name invented in the registry and then cited as though the specification had asked for it. That is the more dangerous direction, because a registered row LOOKS like evidence. `07` section 6 observes allowances without ever naming what they measure, so inventing plausible names for them is a live temptation and exactly what F6X-02 was refused for through two lanes. The vocabulary grows when a chapter names something, never before.
expect_failure_contains: A REGISTERED CAPACITY MEASURE IS NAMED BY NO CHAPTER
